CAPABILITIES sends an unshown kind back (clarify, or an event review that says so) and does not let it be assumed to be demand. The brief designs H10 as not answerable for this reason, and the reviewer's own preferred outcome is clarify. Accepting `resolved` would turn the incidental demand remark into the subject of the forecast, which the incidental family exists to rule out. I keep my record unchanged.
